name: Pharaoh
summary: The king of Egypt who did not know Joseph and feared how many the Israelites had become. He forced them into hard labor and ordered their newborn sons thrown into the river.

key_moments.title: Puts Israel to Hard Labor
key_moments.description: Afraid of Israel's growing numbers, the new king set taskmasters over them, and they built the storage cities Pithom and Raamses for Pharaoh. Yet the harder they were treated, the more they grew.

key_moments.title: Orders the Hebrew Boys Killed
key_moments.description: He told the Hebrew midwives to kill every newborn son, but they feared God and let the boys live. Then Pharaoh commanded all his people to throw every newborn son into the river.

key_moments.title: Seeks to Kill Moses
key_moments.description: When Pharaoh heard that Moses had killed an Egyptian, he tried to kill Moses. Moses fled from him to Midian.
